svg.title: Sandy Explorer — step 3: Build low sand walls
svg.desc: Push a little damp sand to either side of your line to make low walls and a shallow channel between them. Leave the entrance and turns open. If a wall crumbles, add a little damp sand and pat gently. Uneven walls are part of the fun.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Build low walls beside the line

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the entrance and every turn open.
